name: swarm-control
description: SWARM Control: Mac coordinator and browser interface for the nine MauMau modules

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n coord,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w coordinator" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p coordinator --noEmit && npm run check -w web
